component: Q8 resizing and large-image working reduction
status: Private sampling, triangle filtering, native Geometry fit and working reduction match all 32232 native cases. Full suite, fresh installed package and restricted runtime pass. Fresh source/working classification is separately verified by image-state-contract.json; stateful controller/cache lifecycle remains unfinished.
scope: Validated prepared BGRA bytes, explicit positive source/target dimensions and native sampling/filter and matte controls. File decoding and GUI profile selection remain separate.

sample.coordinates: Truncate ((outputCoordinate+0.5)*sourceDimension)/targetDimension in that double order and copy the Q8 pixel. Alpha is copied even when the explicit matte flag is zero.

filtered.filter: Filter 3 maps to triangle 0x4f7c30 with support 1 and box window 0x4f7910. Blur is explicitly 1 for the working-reduction branch.
filtered.passOrder: Horizontal then vertical when (sourceWidth+targetWidth)*targetHeight < (sourceHeight+targetHeight)*targetWidth; otherwise vertical then horizontal. Preserve Q8 quantization between passes.

arithmetic.weights: Float32 target/source ratio and reciprocal. Lower tap bound uses the retained double center minus support minus 1e-6; upper bound and tap distances use its float32 store. Float32 coefficient sums and normalized weights.
arithmetic.matteColors: Effective weight is float32(alpha*weight*(1/255)) with double reciprocal arithmetic. Every BGR accumulation stores float32.
arithmetic.matteOpacity: In each four-tap group, opacity stores float32 after the first and fourth tap; the middle additions retain double precision. Remainder taps store float32.
arithmetic.alphaSum: Four-tap alpha groups store float32 after the second and third tap and retain the fourth double addition; trailing taps accumulate double. The two native axes preserve their original addition order. If abs(alphaSum)<=1e-6 use reciprocal one; otherwise reciprocal is double 1/alphaSum.
arithmetic.nonMatteColors: Blue spills after group taps 1/3/4, green after 3/4, red after 2/3. Red retains double precision through the fourth and trailing taps. Other trailing sums store float32. Opacity stores float32 every tap.
arithmetic.quantization: Clamp each accumulated output to byte range and truncate(value+0.5); convert opacity back to alpha. Preserve Q8 bytes between passes, including same-size filtered passes.

filtered.matte: Use the explicit original Image::matte flag. Native Q8 stores opacity=255-alpha. Filtered colors depend on opacity when matte is enabled; exported BGRA behavior for disabled matte must also match.

workingImage.scale: Double sqrt(150000/area), then truncate(originalDimension*scale+0.5) for geometry width/height. Original ParseMetaGeometry can subsequently preserve aspect and adjust dimensions.
workingImage.dispatch: Shared::is_anti_aliased at core+0x20c selects native sampling when zero and filter-3 resizing when nonzero.
workingImage.ownership: The original stage retains its preprocessed cache and resizes a local Q8 image before exporting the working byte grid. Capture both dimensions and pixels to establish this behavior.
workingImage.geometry: Native Geometry omits zero width/height in its text producer. Two nonzero dimensions select min(double width ratio, float32 height ratio). A single nonzero requested dimension first converts its integer value to float32, then divides by the source dimension in double. Unchanged or empty Geometry returns source dimensions; other results use half-up integer conversion and clamp each dimension to one.

sourceGradientRecovery.scope: Native evidence for the next integration stage, not shipped source-gradient integration. Original Gaussian blur retains full preprocessed source dimensions; gradient loops use working dimensions and each raster own row stride. Working pixels remain unchanged.
